title: Vessel-specific voyage optimization with machine learning: Manta on AWS
summary: Manta Marine Technologies closes the gap between seemingly identical ships by training machine learning models on each vessel's own operational history. Learn how Manta delivers vessel-specific voyage optimization on AWS to help shipowners reduce fuel consumption and improve voyage efficiency.

title: How Anchorage Digital and Turnkey verify code with AWS Nitro Enclaves
summary: Anchorage Digital and Turnkey built verifiable infrastructure on AWS Nitro Enclaves so crypto wallets can cryptographically verify which code parsed a transaction. This post covers the architecture, the attestation-gated access pattern, and how it extends to any high-trust workflow beyond blockchain.

title: Data governance with annotations in Amazon S3
summary: Attach governance context such as classification, retention, residency, and PII flags directly to your Amazon S3 objects with S3 annotations. This post walks through the end-to-end pattern and the handful of S3 behaviors that decide whether your governance design is correct.

title: Recommended resilience testing in the next generation of AWS Resilience Hub
summary: The next generation of AWS Resilience Hub introduces recommended resilience testing: four pre-configured, AWS FIS-powered tests that validate how your service detects and recovers from failures across Availability Zones, dependencies, and Regions, turning your resilience policy into evidence-backed pass or fail results.

title: Automate medical coding with Step Functions and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
summary: Learn how to combine deterministic orchestration with bounded agentic reasoning using AWS Step Functions and the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness. This medical coding workflow escalates cheapest-first: a safety block-list, then exact matching, then an AI agent only for terms that need judgment, keeping every routing decision auditable.

title: How Dynata scaled AI across the development lifecycle with AI-DLC and Kiro IDE
summary: Dynata reimagined its development lifecycle with AI, moving from AI-assisted coding to the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) methodology with Kiro IDE. Learn how the company reduced the development phase of full-stack features from three to four sprints to roughly one, with every team aligned from the start.

title: Multi-region disaster recovery for Amazon API Gateway WebSocket APIs
summary: Learn how to build multi-region disaster recovery for Amazon API Gateway WebSocket APIs. This design pattern combines Amazon Route 53 DNS failover, Amazon DynamoDB Global Tables, a canary health probe, and client-side reconnection logic to reconnect clients and restore session state automatically during a regional failover.

title: How UTS established a modern curriculum data services foundation on AWS
summary: The University of Technology Sydney built a modern curriculum data services foundation on AWS that treats curriculum data as a governed, reusable product, available through APIs, graph traversal, semantic search, and event delivery, while leaving the source Curriculum Management System authoritative. One engineer now operates the domain.
